name: BSP_Memory_AllocZeroed
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __fastcall(size /*ECX*/): operator new (00bf55be) followed by memset(p, 0, size) (00bf79f0), returning the block. Used by 00964790 for 19 of the 22 vehicle-class descriptors; the other three sites were inlined by the compiler. See docs/SCENE_UNIT_CREATORS.md.
